verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a compliance-automation platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documented self-hosted, on-prem, or downloadable deployment option. It describes Sprinto only as a cloud platform running on vendor-hosted regional apps (e.g. eu.sprinto.com), and the open-source compliance-skills repo is a set of agent skills, not the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
